faq.supportTitle: Let’s look at your site together.
faq.supportDescription: A free security assessment turns general questions into a practical recommendation for your location.

items.question: Do we need to replace our existing CCTV system?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Overwatch assesses your existing CCTV infrastructure and retains compatible equipment wherever practical. Where equipment is not suitable for the required security objective, we recommend the necessary improvements.

items.question: Does Overwatch replace physical guards?
items.answer: Not automatically. Overwatch can complement guards through remote monitoring, stronger supervision, procedures and incident verification. Depending on the site and security model, better use of technology may also allow guarding resources to be deployed more effectively.

items.question: Does AI make the security decision?
items.answer: No. AI helps identify relevant events. Overwatch operators review alerts and determine whether escalation is required.

items.question: Do you install CCTV?
items.answer: Overwatch assesses the technical requirement and coordinates CCTV installation or upgrades with approved technical partners.

items.question: What happens when an incident is detected?
items.answer: An Overwatch operator reviews the event. If action is required, the incident is escalated according to the protocol agreed with the client.

items.question: Can Overwatch monitor more than one site?
items.answer: Yes. Overwatch can support organisations operating multiple locations, subject to assessment and technical requirements.

items.question: Is the service only for after-hours monitoring?
items.answer: No. Monitoring can be configured according to the requirements of the client and may include after-hours activity, restricted areas, operational events and other agreed periods.

items.question: Can Overwatch help reduce stock loss?
items.answer: Overwatch can improve visibility, detection, accountability and incident investigation around stock and operational areas. Effective loss prevention normally requires a combination of monitoring, procedures, access controls and security management.

items.question: Can Overwatch provide a Security Manager?
items.answer: Yes. Security Manager services are available according to the operational requirements of the client or project.

items.question: How do I know which services I need?
items.answer: Start with a free security assessment. We assess the existing operation and recommend only the services and improvements that are appropriate for the site.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy | OverWatch Mozambique
metadata.description: Learn how OverWatch Mozambique protects personal data, CCTV footage, AI metadata, and information collected during security monitoring services.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Overwatch Lda ("Overwatch", "we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data of our clients, website visitors, and individuals recorded by our security systems. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard your data when you use our website, interact with our services, or are monitored by our CCTV and AI systems on behalf of our clients.

subsections.title: A. Information provided directly by you:

items.label: Contact Information:
items.text: Name, email address, phone number, and company details when you request a security assessment or contact us.

items.label: Account Information:
items.text: Credentials used to access the Overwatch client dashboard.

subsections.title: B. Information collected through our Security Services:

items.label: Video & Audio Feeds:
items.text: Live and recorded CCTV footage from cameras installed at client premises.

items.label: AI Metadata:
items.text: Analytical data generated by our AI systems, including object detection (vehicles, persons), intrusion alerts, and movement tracking.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

items.text: To provide, manage, and monitor the security services contracted by our clients.
To detect, verify, and respond to security threats, intrusions, and unauthorized access using our surveillance control room.
To communicate with you regarding your account, technical support, and critical security alerts.
To train and improve our AI detection algorithms (video data used for this purpose is aggregated and anonymized wherever possible).

sections.title: 4. Data Controller vs. Data Processor
paragraphs: For the video surveillance footage and AI metadata collected on our clients' premises, the Client is the Data Controller. Overwatch acts strictly as the Data Processor, processing this footage solely on the instructions of the client to ensure the security of their site. Any individual wishing to exercise their privacy rights regarding CCTV footage should contact the respective property owner (the client) directly.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention and Security
paragraphs: We implement industry-standard encryption, firewalls, and strict access controls within our surveillance control room to protect all data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

CCTV footage is retained only for the period specified in the client's contract (typically 14 to 30 days) unless required longer for an ongoing security investigation or law enforcement request, after which it is securely deleted.

sections.title: 6. Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with:

items.label: Law Enforcement:
items.text: When legally required to do so, or when turning over evidence of a crime detected on a client's premises.

items.label: Service Providers:
items.text: Trusted third-party infrastructure providers (e.g., cloud hosting) who are bound by strict confidentiality agreements.

sections.title: 7. Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

sections.title: 3. Client Responsibilities
paragraphs: As a client, you agree to:

items.text: Provide accurate and complete information regarding your site layout, current security systems, and operational procedures during our security assessments.
Ensure that any existing CCTV hardware you wish to integrate meets our minimum technical specifications for AI detection compatibility.
Maintain reliable power and internet connectivity at your premises to allow our surveillance control room to receive uninterrupted feeds, unless an off-grid solution is explicitly provided by us.
Comply with all local laws and regulations regarding the use of surveillance equipment and the recording of individuals on your property.

linkParagraph.after: We act as a data processor in respect of the video footage captured on your premises. You remain the data controller and are responsible for ensuring that you have the lawful basis to record and monitor your site.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: While Overwatch utilizes state-of-the-art AI detection and rigorous control room protocols, security systems are inherently subject to limitations (e.g., severe weather obstructing camera views, power grid failures, or network outages).

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Overwatch shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of profits or revenues, whether incurred directly or indirectly, or any loss of data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses resulting from breaches of security at your premises.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: All software, AI models, dashboards, trademarks, and proprietary methodologies used to deliver our services remain the exclusive property of Overwatch. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access our client dashboard for the duration of your contract.

sections.title: 7. Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Mozambique. Any disputes arising under or in connection with these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Maputo.

story.title: Built around a problem businesses know too well
paragraphs: Many sites already have cameras, guards, and procedures—but those parts often work separately. Cameras record. Guards patrol. Incidents are reviewed after the damage is done.

Overwatch brings those pieces into one coordinated operation. Intelligent monitoring surfaces relevant activity, people verify what matters, and clear escalation procedures help the right response begin sooner.

We start with what is already there. When existing cameras and systems are suitable, we integrate them. When there are gaps, we identify them clearly and recommend the improvements the site actually needs.
